{{Top|leg}}
The '''survival-regressive-isolationist theory''' was proposed by [[Arner Figgis]]. It theorized that social groups cut off from their larger society were forced to revert to a more primitive state to ensure the survival of their group. [[Sentientologist]]s claimed that the [[Bharhulai]] tribe of [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] were an example of the theory, under the assumption that the tribe were the descendants of the survivors of one of the [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]] that settled Socorro. The ship crashed and the group were cut off from their fellow [[Colonist/Legends|Colonists]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
